about: A filled example of templates/prove/claims.json: claims about this lab, each measured by one of its own commands in seconds. node tools/claims.mjs templates/prove/claims.example.json writes templates/prove/proof.example.md.

claims.claim: Every item the work list marks done names a test that exists.
Every path and marked number in README.md and AGENTS.md matches the repository.
What AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md load at the start of a session fits in 200 lines and about 4,000 tokens.
Every feature of the approval queue rests on a decision and has a test that exists.
A real model passes the triage assistant's golden sets.
